description: End-to-end conversations through the real assistant (local model, personal records, memory with embeddings). The clock starts on Friday 9 October 2026, 10:00. Each step is one of: 'say' (a request; its reply must match every 'all' and at least one 'any' pattern, and no 'forbid' pattern; case-insensitive regex), 'advance' (minutes), 'restart' (new memory and assistant on the same files, as after a reboot), 'announce' (reminders due now; 'expect' pattern, or null for none), 'briefing' (the startup briefing). Steps with 'known_miss' document a limitation and are reported separately. Every scenario starts with empty memory.

steps.say: Remember that I parked my car on level B2 near pillar 14
Where did I park my car?
Which level is my car on?
Where is my car parked?
Please remember that.
I lent my drill to Ravi.
Who has my drill?
Who did I give my power tool to?
steps.known_miss: Paraphrase too far for MiniLM (similarity below 0.35); also a miss in the memory retrieval benchmark. The reply is an honest 'couldn't find'.
